Items.Value: To ask His Majesty’s Government what plans they have, if any, to extend the scope of the BBC licence fee to households using streaming services; and what assessment they have made of the impact of any such change on (1) household bills, (2) consumer choice, (3) investment and (4) the creative indust

Items.AttributedTo: The Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State, Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport (Baroness Mackenzie of Sherwood) (Lab)
Items.Value: My Lords, as noble Lords are aware, the ongoing charter review is considering how to secure the BBC’s long-term future, including by putting its funding model on a sustainable footing. As set out in the Green Paper, the Government are keeping an open mind on all options, including considering reform
